summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. furnished a routine Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) disclosing preliminary August 2026 Vietnam EV deliveries of 20,161 units, up 12% month-over-month despite Ghost Month seasonality, with year-to-date deliveries of 154,073 units. The VF 3 led at 6,453 units, followed by VF 5/Herio Green at 4,265 and Limo Green at 4,203. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is stated; the filing is an operational update incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. Watch quarterly ASP and cost trends as delivery counts are not revenue indicators.
